next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative BLOCK CONTAINS clause the sequential one. 2023 writes one BLOCK CONTAINS clause (13.18.10) into FD Format 1 ('the file description entry for a sequential file', §2023:13.4.5.3 SR5) and Format 2 ('for a relative file or an indexed file', §2023:13.4.5.3 SR7), so the sameness holds; the clause's content is carried by the sequential rule's record.
